requirements.description: Stop hard-coding "datetimetz" in plottable_types(); let the extension-dtype registry supply it
Provide the Timestamp and Period converter pairs from DatetimeTZDtype/PeriodDtype instead of hard-coding them in get_pairs().

label.evidence: converter.py:87-101 ("datetimetz" removed, EA types via plottable_ea_pairs(), lines 77-84); :107-108 (get_pairs still hard-codes Timestamp and Period); dtype-side changes not in the diff
label.notes: Reviewer comment is a hunch about "datetimetz" being covered by plottable_ea_dtypes; the author later describes an offline agreement to move the Timestamp/Period pairs into the ExtensionDtypes (fec4d87), which is not in this diff. "datetimetz" is removed from plottable_types, but get_pairs still hard-codes (Timestamp, ...) and (Period, ...) at 107-108, and the dtype-side change can't be verified from converter.py.

adjudication_reason: he reviewer suggested handling plotting converter registrations through the extension-dtype mechanism. The changes introduce plottable_ea_pairs() and remove hard-coded dtype strings from plottable_types(). However, get_pairs() still explicitly registers Timestamp and Period converters. Although the author references a separate commit moving these registrations into their respective ExtensionDtype classes, those changes are not visible in the supplied diff. Therefore, full satisfaction cannot be independently verified.
